name: kition-kits
description: Create, edit and check Markdown notes, .ktable tables and HTML pages in your project with the published Kition kits' KHP tools, with no Kition app running. Other Kition kits join as they are published.

kits_mcp.title: kition-kits-mcp
kits_mcp.description: The server executable: kition (started as `kition mcp`; installed by install.sh in ~/.kition/bin or by `npm install -g @kition/cli`, or built with `cargo build -p kition-cli`) or a kition-kits-mcp. Leave empty to use kition on the PATH, else kition-kits-mcp on the PATH, else `npx -y @kition/cli mcp`, which brings kition. kition downloads each kit into ~/.kition/kits on first use.

kits_dir.title: Installed kits
kits_dir.description: A folder with one folder per installed kit, each holding its kit.json and headless executable. Leave empty to use kit repositories, or the kits kition installs in ~/.kition/kits.

kit_repos.title: Kit repositories (development)
kit_repos.description: A folder of kit repository checkouts (kition-<kit>/). Each kit built with `cargo build -p kition-<kit>` is served from target/debug/kition-<kit> with its repository's kit.json.

unified.title: One tool set for all kits
unified.description: On: 10 kit_<action> tools routed by the file's extension, the same 10 however many kits are installed. Off: 10 <prefix>_<action> tools for each installed kit (note_run, note_check, ...).
